title: Una directora Extraordinaria
overview: In December 2018, Mónica, the principal of the Pehuajó National College, hands over the keys to the high school so the bathrooms can be renovated. The work is delayed, and classes begin with portable toilets. One day, the architect disappears. Mónica must fight against bureaucracy and maintain order at the school. The students will join her in her struggle. The film is inspired by a true story.
